subject: Observability bundle: retention + tracing + dashboards — POC credit path and pricing
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Observability bundle: retention + tracing + dashboards — POC credit path and pricing

Hi Marta,

Thanks for the time earlier — great to learn about Acme's plan to standardize telemetry for the new ingestion pipeline. To make next steps concrete, I've sketched a pragmatic packaging path that balances your retention requirements with a low-friction POC: 

- POC scope (6 weeks): 30-day tracing indexed spans + 90-day log retention snapshot with the Advanced Dashboards pre-built widgets (up to 15 seats).
- Pilot credits: we can provide $15k in observability credits (applies to ingestion/storage) to cover the POC ingestion volume.
- Production options: two SKUs — Retention (12-mo archival tier or 30-day hot tier), Tracing (30d indexed / 90d sampled), Dashboards (seat-based).

To price this accurately, could you confirm approximate monthly ingestion (events/day), average spans/day, and expected dashboard users? I pulled a quick export from your trial (attached usage_snapshot-May2027.csv) but wanted your confirmation.

If that aligns, I'll put together a short SOW and a one-page pricing sheet for an annual commit vs month-to-month. Quick ask: are you able to consider an annual commitment for at least the retention storage (common ask from customers to get deeper discounts)?

Thanks —
Jasmine

--
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acme-analytics.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diego Soto <diego.soto@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability bundle: retention + tracing + dashboards — POC credit path and pricing

Thanks, Jasmine — useful outline. A few clarifications and constraints from our side: 

- Production requirements: 12 months retained logs for audit/data lineage; 30 days of indexed traces (we can sample beyond that for cold storage).
- Current ingest: ~18M events/day (~540M/month) during normal ops; we expect bursts up to ~30M/day.
- Spans: ~2.5M spans/day.
- Dashboards: 15 power users, ~50 viewers.
- Procurement: Acme typically requires a 12-month minimum term to trigger procurement approval and prefers a committed spend for predictable budgeting.

We are very interested in the POC credits you mentioned but need to understand the delta to production. Specifically: what would an annual price look like for the full retention (12mo), tracing 30d indexed, and 15-seat Advanced Dashboards? Can you provide a sample invoice cadence (monthly vs upfront) and any sliding discounts for higher commit levels?

Attaching a short doc with our retention matrix for your reference (Acme_Retention_Reqs.pdf).

Best,
Marta
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 14:39:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability bundle: retention + tracing + dashboards — POC credit path and pricing

Marta — thanks for the detail, that helps. High-level commercial framing below (I will follow with a one-page pricing table + SOW draft):

Option A — Annual committed (preferred):
- Logs retention (12 months archival + 30-day hot tier): $11,500/month (includes 600M events/month baseline ingestion).
- Tracing (30d fully indexed up to 3M spans/day): $6,200/month.
- Advanced Dashboards (15 seats + 50 viewer licenses): $1,800/month.
- Total: $19,500/month before discounts.
- Commit discount tiers: 10% @ 12mo, 18% @ 24mo, 25% @ 36mo.

Option B — Pilot -> expand (POC path):
- Pilot credits: $15k applied to ingestion/storage for first 3 months.
- If production is activated within 90 days and you sign a 12mo commit, we'll convert credits and apply a one-time onboarding credit (equivalent to 1 month) and a 15% first-year concession on list.

Concessions & special asks: given the scale you shared (peak ingestion / spans), I ran this by Rishi to check room on concessions. We can structure a two-line discount: (1) 15% first-year concession for a 12mo commit that covers retention and tracing, and (2) an onboarding credit to offset migration. We need a firm commit to get procurement moving.

I attached a draft SOW and a short example invoice cadence (redwood-sow-observability-draft.pdf); I'll get our pricing table into a Google sheet and share a link. Would you be open to a short call tomorrow to walk the finance/technical folks through the breakdown?

Cheers,
Jasmine

Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability bundle: retention + tracing + dashboards — POC credit path and pricing

Team — quick internal: I reviewed the numbers from Jasmine and the ask from Acme. Given their scale and strategic fit, I am willing to approve a commercial concession with these conditions: 

- Approval: 20% first-year discount on the blended list of $19,500/month (reduces to $15,600/month) conditional on a 12-months minimum term and a 45-day payment SLA.
- Pilot: $12k pilot credit (reduced from Jasmine's $15k ask) to be applied to ingestion/storage for the first 2 months; any unused pilot credit is non-refundable but can be applied to month 3 if production is enabled.
- Legal: require standard SOW + security addendum, and a short SLA appendix referencing our Dedicated uptime targets for their prod workload.
- Finance: requires a PO or signed order form before credits are applied.

Please confirm if everyone is aligned; Jasmine, proceed with the SOW update and a short pricing sheet. Lauren/Marissa, can you quick-review the SOW for procurement language so we can share the package with Marta early next week?

Rishi
VP, Commercial Operations
